context: Tests whether the agent uses UPPER_CASE variable names, quotes variable references in recipe lines, adds ## Description comments for the help system, uses @ prefix, delegates to scripts, and uses flat targets (not subdirectory Makefiles) for single-command concerns.

checklist.name: UPPER_CASE variable names
checklist.description: All makefile variable definitions use UPPER_CASE names (e.g. ENV, REGISTRY, VERSION — not env, registry, or version)

checklist.name: Quoted variable references
checklist.description: Recipe lines that pass variables to scripts use quoted references in the form `"$(VAR)"` (e.g. `"$(ENV)"`, `"$(REGISTRY)"`, `"$(VERSION)"`) — not bare `$(VAR)`

checklist.name: .DEFAULT_GOAL set
checklist.description: Root Makefile contains `.DEFAULT_GOAL := help` so bare `make` shows help

checklist.name: Flat targets for single commands
checklist.description: Neither `build` nor `deploy` has a `mk/build/Makefile` or `mk/deploy/Makefile` subdirectory — each is a flat target (no subdirectory Makefile needed for a single-command concern)

checklist.name: Script delegation
checklist.description: Recipe lines invoke the existing scripts (references to `scripts/docker-build.sh` and `scripts/deploy.sh`) rather than containing inline bash logic

checklist.name: PHONY declarations
checklist.description: The build, deploy, and help targets (and any other non-file-producing targets) are declared `.PHONY`

checklist.name: @ prefix on recipes
checklist.description: All recipe lines use `@` prefix to suppress command echoing

checklist.name: Help grouped by concern
checklist.description: make-help-output.txt shows commands grouped under labelled sections (e.g. separate headings or groupings for build and deploy operations)

checklist.name: Lowercase hyphenated target names
checklist.description: All target names are lowercase; any multi-word names use hyphens (not underscores or camelCase)

checklist.name: Variable defaults defined
checklist.description: Makefile defines default values for the configurable variables (ENV, VERSION, or REGISTRY) so targets work without requiring the user to set them

checklist.name: ## Description comments
checklist.description: Targets that appear in make help have inline `## <description>` comments (e.g. `build: ## Build the container image`) used to power the help system
